product.name: Dentai
product.positioning: Context-aware clinical & patient care copilot for Australian dental practices. Documentation software: does not diagnose or prescribe; the treating practitioner reviews and owns every record.
product.architecture: Single Express app (server.ts) + React 19/Vite client; Gemini via @google/genai as hosted verbaliser over a canonical ClinicalFact pipeline; Postgres (Neon) when DATABASE_URL set, JSON-file fallback failing closed unless DENTAI_ALLOW_FILE_STORAGE=true; Vercel serverless via api/index.ts.
product.packageManager: Bun (bun.lock). Do not add npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles.
product.lifecycleStage: Release candidate 0.1.0-rc.1; docs/FINAL_CLINICAL_SAFETY_AUDIT.md verdict ARCHITECTURALLY COMPLETE with documented Postgres test-environment gap.

clinicalScope.productClass: Clinical documentation software (not a diagnostic device)
